caption:
Nobody wakes up wanting their couch cleaned.

Which is why waiting to be found doesn’t work in this trade. You can be first on every search and still have an empty week — the problem isn’t ranking, it’s that almost nobody is searching.

People book this after they see it. One clip of a filthy cushion turning clean does more than any ad about your equipment or your years in business. Nobody knew they wanted it. Then they watched, looked at their own couch, and knew.

Count your last twenty jobs. How many came from someone actively looking for you, and how many from someone who saw something and remembered? That ratio is your business model, whether you chose it or not.

Your work is the content. We turn the before and after you already produce every day into the thing that makes a stranger look at their own living room.

Comment your city and I'll check how you show up — where you land, who's above you, and what they're doing that you're not. No charge, no call.

Follow @davis.mkt for more ways to fill your calendar.
